description: One or more requests per supported SQL capability (development suite).

cases.question: List every store with its city.
gold_sql: SELECT name, city FROM stores

cases.question: Which products cost more than 100?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > 100

cases.question: Which products cost at most 2.5?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price <= 2.5

cases.question: Which gold-tier customers live in Paris or Lyon?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city IN ('Paris', 'Lyon') AND loyalty_tier = 'gold'

cases.question: List products that are discontinued or cost more than 100.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE discontinued = 1 OR price > 100

cases.question: How many orders are pending or returned?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('pending', 'returned')

cases.question: Which products are priced between 3 and 4?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 3 AND 4

cases.question: Which products have 'Blend' in their name?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%Blend%'

cases.question: Which suppliers' names start with K?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE name LIKE 'K%'

cases.question: How many customers have no email address?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE email IS NULL

cases.question: Which different cities do our customers live in?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers

cases.question: List the departments from the largest budget to the smallest.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM departments ORDER BY budget DESC
SELECT name, budget FROM departments ORDER BY budget DESC

cases.question: What are the three most expensive products?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Which product has the second highest price?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

cases.question: List each product with the country of its supplier.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, T2.country FROM products T1 JOIN suppliers T2 ON T1.supplier_id = T2.id

cases.question: Which regions have stores that sold Croissants?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T5.name FROM order_items T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id JOIN orders T3 ON T1.order_id = T3.id JOIN stores T4 ON T3.store_id = T4.id JOIN regions T5 ON T4.region_id = T5.id WHERE T2.name = 'Croissant'

cases.question: Which employees work in the same store as their manager?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM employees T1 JOIN employees T2 ON T1.manager_id = T2.id WHERE T1.store_id = T2.store_id

cases.question: List each employee together with the name of their manager.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, T2.name FROM employees T1 JOIN employees T2 ON T1.manager_id = T2.id

cases.question: Which employees were hired before their manager?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM employees T1 JOIN employees T2 ON T1.manager_id = T2.id WHERE T1.hire_date < T2.hire_date

cases.question: How many orders does each customer have, including customers with no orders?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, COUNT(T2.id) FROM customers T1 LEFT JOIN orders T2 ON T2.customer_id = T1.id GROUP BY T1.id

cases.question: What is the average salary in each department?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name, AVG(T1.salary) FROM employees T1 JOIN departments T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id

cases.question: Which departments have an average salary above 5000?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM employees T1 JOIN departments T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id HAVING AVG(T1.salary) > 5000

cases.question: How many different customers placed an order in March 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2024-03%'

cases.question: What is the average number of orders per customer?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers) FROM orders
SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id)

cases.question: What is the average order value?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(v) FROM (SELECT SUM(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) AS v FROM order_items T1 GROUP BY T1.order_id)

cases.question: Which customers placed more orders than the average customer?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM customers T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T2.customer_id = T1.id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers) FROM orders)

cases.question: What percentage of orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(status = 'cancelled') / COUNT(*) FROM orders

cases.question: What is the total revenue of each category?
gold_sql: SELECT T3.name, SUM(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) FROM order_items T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id JOIN categories T3 ON T2.category_id = T3.id GROUP BY T3.id

cases.question: Which product generated the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM order_items T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY SUM(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.name, SUM(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) FROM order_items T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY SUM(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Who are the top 3 customers by total spending?
gold_sql: SELECT T3.name FROM order_items T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.id JOIN customers T3 ON T2.customer_id = T3.id GROUP BY T3.id ORDER BY SUM(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT T3.name, SUM(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) FROM order_items T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.id JOIN customers T3 ON T2.customer_id = T3.id GROUP BY T3.id ORDER BY SUM(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: How much budget does each department have left after paying salaries?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name, T2.budget - SUM(T1.salary) FROM employees T1 JOIN departments T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id

cases.question: Which suppliers have no discontinued products?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT supplier_id FROM products WHERE discontinued = 1)

cases.question: Which customers have never placed a cancelled order?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled')

cases.question: Which customers bought products from Japanese suppliers?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id IN (SELECT T2.customer_id FROM order_items T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.id JOIN products T3 ON T1.product_id = T3.id JOIN suppliers T4 ON T3.supplier_id = T4.id WHERE T4.country = 'Japan')

cases.question: Which products cost more than the average product?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)

cases.question: Which employees earn more than the average salary of their department?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM employees T1 WHERE T1.salary > (SELECT AVG(T2.salary) FROM employees T2 WHERE T2.department_id = T1.department_id)

cases.question: Which stores have both cancelled and returned orders?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM orders T1 JOIN stores T2 ON T1.store_id = T2.id WHERE T1.status = 'cancelled' INTERSECT SELECT T2.name FROM orders T1 JOIN stores T2 ON T1.store_id = T2.id WHERE T1.status = 'returned'

cases.question: Which supplier countries supply both coffee and tea products?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.country FROM products T1 JOIN suppliers T2 ON T1.supplier_id = T2.id JOIN categories T3 ON T1.category_id = T3.id WHERE T3.name = 'Coffee' INTERSECT SELECT T2.country FROM products T1 JOIN suppliers T2 ON T1.supplier_id = T2.id JOIN categories T3 ON T1.category_id = T3.id WHERE T3.name = 'Tea'

cases.question: What is the most expensive product in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM products T1 WHERE T1.price = (SELECT MAX(T2.price) FROM products T2 WHERE T2.category_id = T1.category_id)
SELECT T2.name, T1.name FROM products T1 JOIN categories T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.id WHERE T1.price = (SELECT MAX(T3.price) FROM products T3 WHERE T3.category_id = T1.category_id)

cases.question: List the two cheapest products in each category.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM (SELECT name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY price) AS r FROM products) WHERE r <= 2

cases.question: Which categories have only products priced under 20?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM categories WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT category_id FROM products WHERE price >= 20)

cases.question: How many orders were placed in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2024%'

cases.question: How many customers signed up after 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', signup_date) > '2022'

cases.question: How many orders were placed in each month?
gold_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_date), COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

cases.question: Which month had the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_date) FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_date), COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many orders were placed in the first quarter of 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31'

cases.question: How many years had each employee worked by the end of 2024? Show their names.
gold_sql: SELECT name, (JULIANDAY('2024-12-31') - JULIANDAY(hire_date)) / 365.25 FROM employees

cases.question: How many products does each supplier provide?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name, COUNT(*) FROM products T1 JOIN suppliers T2 ON T1.supplier_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id

cases.question: For every supplier, count its products.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name, COUNT(*) FROM products T1 JOIN suppliers T2 ON T1.supplier_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id

cases.question: Number of products per vendor?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name, COUNT(*) FROM products T1 JOIN suppliers T2 ON T1.supplier_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id

cases.question: Which customers have not ordered anything?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

cases.question: List customers without any orders.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

cases.question: Who are the customers that never placed an order?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

cases.question: Top 3 products by revenue
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM order_items T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY SUM(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT T2.name, SUM(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) FROM order_items T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY SUM(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Top 3 products by number of orders
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM order_items T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT T2.name, COUNT(*) FROM order_items T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: What is the average order line value?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.quantity * T1.unit_price) FROM order_items T1
